paper.title_en: Profile Reconstruction from Temporally Stable Emission Components for Timing PSR J1713+0747
paper.abstract_en: The assumption of long-term pulse-profile stability underpins high-precision pulsar timing and forms the basis of pulsar timing array experiments. However, several millisecond pulsars exhibit temporal profile variability that can introduce systematic biases in pulse time of arrival measurements and compromise timing precision. We present a profile-domain analysis of PSR J1713+0747 at low radio frequencies, in the 300-500 MHz band, using upgraded GMRT observations for the Indian Pulsar Timing Array experiment. We model frequency-resolved pulse profiles using a Bayesian Gaussian decomposition framework in which individual Gaussian components are associated with persistent emission regions through informative phase priors that permit modest temporal variations. By tracking the evolution of the decomposed components across observing epochs and frequency sub-bands, we identify central Gaussian components that remain precisely localized despite changes in the integrated pulse morphology. We then reconstruct pulse profiles with realistic noise using these central components and perform timing analysis. Our approach provides a physically motivated framework for mitigating pulse-profile variability and offers a generic methodology for recovering robust timing information from pulsars exhibiting profile evolution.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该研究直接针对脉冲星计时阵列中的关键挑战——轮廓变化，提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯高斯分解方法，以减轻对计时精度的影响。方法严谨，结果具有普遍适用性，对PTA科学具有重要意义。
decision.title_zh: 利用瞬态稳定发射分量重构PSR J1713+0747的脉冲轮廓
decision.abstract_zh: 长期脉冲轮廓稳定性的假设支撑着高精度脉冲星计时，并构成脉冲星计时阵列实验的基础。然而，一些毫秒脉冲星表现出时间轮廓变化，这可能引入脉冲到达时间测量的系统偏差并损害计时精度。我们利用升级后的GMRT为印度脉冲星计时阵列实验在300-500 MHz频段的低频无线电观测，呈现了对PSR J1713+0747的轮廓域分析。我们使用贝叶斯高斯分解框架对频率分辨的脉冲轮廓进行建模，其中各个高斯分量通过与持续发射区域相关联的信息相位先验相关联，允许适度的临时变化。通过跟踪分解分量在观测历元和频率子带间的演化，我们识别出即使在集成脉冲形态变化下仍保持精确定位的中心高斯分量。然后我们使用这些中心分量重建具有真实噪声的脉冲轮廓并进行计时分析。我们的方法为减轻脉冲轮廓变化提供了一个物理动机框架，并为从表现出轮廓演化的脉冲星中恢复稳健计时信息提供了一种通用方法。
